perks.embeddedLead: Codes guests claim in the app (redemption counts shown). Separate from marketing offers on this page.

offers.title: Offers & promos
offers.lead: Guest-facing offers on the home card (separate from perk codes). Only ACTIVE rows inside their date window appear in the app. Mark one as Featured for the spotlight slot; guests can redeem when you set per-player or global caps.
offers.headline: Headline
offers.headlinePlaceholder: e.g. Free pastry with any drink

challenges.embeddedLead: Goals and schedules for this venue. Times are stored in UTC; adjust windows with care for your audience.

nudges.title: Venue nudges
nudges.lead: Marketing pushes tied to on-site dwell. Resolution order: assignment overrides → venue-wide fallback (super admin) → template → env defaults; category templates apply when nothing is attached.
nudges.autoExplainer: Automatic: while a guest is on site, after their dwell time (lowest sort order assignment wins — use per-assignment or template default minutes, else global VENUE_ORDER_NUDGE_AFTER_MINUTES), we send one push per visit using that row's copy (assignment overrides → venue-wide fallback fields below → template → env). If this venue has no assignments, legacy matching by venue categories still applies.
nudges.triggerExplainer: Trigger now (super admin): sends the selected assignment's copy immediately to players with fresh presence at this venue (last ~10 minutes), respecting privacy/marketing prefs. Throttled per venue (default 120s, VENUE_NUDGE_ADMIN_TRIGGER_MIN_SECONDS).
nudges.libraryLead: Reusable templates. Attach them to this venue below; optional VenueType links in the DB still drive defaults when a venue has no assignments.
nudges.removeConfirm: Remove this nudge from the venue?
nudges.assignmentsLead: Lower sort order runs first for automatic dwell selection. Per-row overrides replace template text or dwell minutes for this venue only.
nudges.attachLead: Pick a template and optional overrides. Lower sort order = higher priority when multiple assignments match.
nudges.overridesHint: Optional overrides when adding (leave blank for template defaults):
nudges.emptyAssignments: No nudges attached — legacy category templates may still apply.
nudges.triggerResult: Sent to {{attempted}} player(s) currently at this venue (approx. {{tokens}} with push tokens).
nudges.fallbackLead: Used when an assignment has no override and the template/env defaults are not enough.

editor.orgAccessLead: Who owns this venue, suspension, and guest play limits.
editor.orgSearchHint: Link this venue to a billing org, or leave unset. Manage orgs in
editor.orgSearchHintSuperAdmin: Results load in pages of 20 (search is debounced). Manage billing and structure under
editor.orgReadOnlyHint: Only super admins can reassign organization here. Partners manage billing from the partner portal.
editor.orgReadOnlyHintPlatform: Only platform admins can attach or move a venue between organizations.
editor.requiresCheckInHint: Geofence still detects the venue, but games and venue-gated perks stay locked until the player scans the venue QR with location on (GPS must be inside the geofence). Leave off for automatic unlock when detected inside the fence.
editor.guestCapHint: Max QR / guest play sessions per player per calendar day at this venue. Leave empty for the organization default, then the platform env fallback.
editor.staffLead: Clerk-backed access: invite people with their real sign-in email. They use this partner portal in the same Clerk project—employees see verification lists; managers and owners see analytics and campaigns.
editor.saveLead: Writes everything in this form (organization, access, URLs, categories, geofence, nudges, fallback copy, analytics). Perks and challenges below save on their own actions.
editor.locationLead: Place the pin and draw the play-area polygon. Moving the pin re-centers nearby alerts (default 100 m) — adjust presets or custom radius below before saving.
editor.geofenceAlertTitle: Draw a geofence to enable in-venue detection
editor.geofenceAlertBody: Without a polygon, apps cannot tell when players are inside this venue's play space. Use the map tools below to add one before saving.
editor.errGeofenceRequired: Draw a play-area polygon on the map (or keep the existing one) before saving location changes.
editor.errGuestCapInvalid: Guest daily game cap must be empty (inherit) or an integer 1–999.
editor.menuLead: Public links surfaced in the player experience (for example from venue detail or nudges). Use full URLs including https://. Leave blank if not applicable.
editor.categoriesLead: Pick any that apply (for example a coffee shop that also sells games). Dwell push copy is chosen from platform templates using these categories; env defaults apply if none match.
editor.addCategoryLead: Creates a new global tag (e.g. BOARD_GAME_CAFE). It appears in this list for every venue; link nudge templates to this code in the database if you want template-based copy for it.
editor.copyFallbackLead: Optional. Used after per-assignment overrides but before template defaults when resolving automatic nudges. Supports {{venueName}}.
editor.analyticsLead: IANA timezone for owner-facing hour-of-day charts in this portal. Leave empty to use the default from the environment or organization.
editor.saveConfirmBody: Save changes to {{name}}? You will return to the venue list.
editor.lockConfirmBody: Players lose access to this venue on the map and in play until you unlock it again. You still need to save the form for the lock to apply.

geofence.instruction1: Drag the blue <bold>pin</bold> to your venue entrance or main reference point.
geofence.instruction2: In the toolbar (top-left), open <bold>Draw polygon</bold>. Click each corner of the play area; finish by clicking the first point again.
geofence.instruction3: The pin must sit <bold>inside</bold> the polygon. Adjust with the edit tools, or remove with the trash icon and draw again.
geofence.arrivalLead: Circle centered on the pin — players get one offer push per day when they enter this ring. Moving the pin re-centers the ring and resets to 100 m (choose presets or custom before save). Super-admin only. Separate from the play-area polygon.
